title: Conditional two-sided history recurrence to all-shape exhaustion Cauchy transfer
question: If the existing two-orientation shell envelope is supplied by a common-domain, two-sided history recurrence, what exact all-shape exhaustion Cauchy bound follows, and does its scalar tail vanish without a finite-table extrapolation?

theorem.history_contract: For each orientation sigma and each nested pair of boxes agreeing through radius R-1, Delta Y_sigma is the finite sum of actual history terms X_(sigma,e) over changed edges, in one common L4 domain, with ||X_(sigma,e)||_4^4 <= C4_edge*w(e)^4.
theorem.cauchy_bound: ||Y_Lambda'-Y_Lambda||_4^4 <= 16*C4_edge*T(R)^4 when the two boxes agree through radius R-1
theorem.geometric_envelope: T(R) <= 78*(23/26)^(R-1), hence T(R) tends to zero
theorem.conclusion: Under the declared common-domain and two-sided recurrence assumptions, every all-shape exhaustion whose pairwise differences escape to radius infinity is L4-Cauchy.

finite_fixture.shape_statement: No new finite grid is used; shape independence is an abstract agreement-through-radius implication.

assumptions: The R-450 conditional two-orientation shell envelope is available on one common L4 space or form domain.
For every nested pair agreeing through radius R-1, both orientation differences have a finite additive history decomposition over changed edges.
The per-edge fourth-power majorant uses one C4_edge and the R-444 weight in both orientations, independent of shape and history depth.
The finite additive decomposition is consistent on triple-nested boxes, so pairwise differences obey the same shell contract.
The standard geometric fact that a polynomial times a ratio strictly below one vanishes at infinity is used only for the scalar tail; it is not a Q3 operator theorem.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK history and actual per-edge terms satisfying the contract.
A common unbounded operator/form domain and a proof that the actual history terms live there.
Source-, beta-, cutoff-, volume-, shape-, phase- and history-uniform C4_edge and recurrence constants.
A proved all-shape exhaustion map for the production observable and identification of the same observable across shapes.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, common alpha, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.

adversarial_review.check: Does the transfer silently treat the conditional recurrence as an already supplied Q3 history?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: the recurrence is an explicit assumption and actual Q3 history remains false.

adversarial_review.check: Does the triangle inequality compare terms living in unrelated finite spaces?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: one common L4 space/form domain is a required assumption, not a conclusion.

adversarial_review.check: Does agreement through radius R-1 alone prove that arbitrary production observables have a consistent edge decomposition?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: decomposition consistency is assumed and the production observable is not identified.

adversarial_review.check: Is the factor 16 in the total two-orientation fourth-power bound explicit?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD: it follows from the nonnegative fourth-power sum inequality and two orientation bounds.

adversarial_review.check: Could the 1..64 rows be read as a continuum or exhaustion result?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: rows audit the exact scalar ratio; the vanishing envelope is an analytic conditional implication.

adversarial_review.check: Does this conditional transfer replace T-054, T-059 or T-061?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive T-054 interface and leaves the existing methods, owner order and inverse lane unchanged.

adversarial_review.check: Could a conditional Cauchy implication be promoted to common alpha, OS/GNS, physical or Clay closure?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: all downstream scope flags remain false.

evidence_level: T0 exact conditional recurrence-to-Cauchy transfer with analytic geometric-tail envelope
boundary: R-451 proves only an abstract implication: if a source-owned, common-domain two-sided history recurrence satisfies the existing R-450 per-edge contract, then pairwise all-shape differences admit a root-free L4 fourth-power Cauchy bound controlled by T(R), and the scalar envelope vanishes. It does not supply the recurrence, the domain, the production observable, or any physical or continuum identification.
non_claims: No actual Q3LOCK history or source-owned per-edge commutator estimate is established.
No common unbounded domain, form closure, source/volume/cutoff/beta uniformity or exhaustion map is established.
The abstract Cauchy implication is not an OS/KMS/GNS, common-alpha, physical-sector, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap result.
No new finite grid or mobility table is used as an infinite-limit surrogate.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order and promotion firewalls remain unchanged.
next_action: Use R-451 only when a source-owned Q3 history and common domain are supplied; instantiate its recurrence hypotheses and then test the actual all-shape Cauchy estimate. Until then, continue the existing T-054 owner-intake boundary and the additive T-059/T-061 observation-source lock without another finite table.
stop_or_redesign: If an actual history term violates the per-edge contract, record that local failure rather than enlarging C4_edge.
If the decomposition is not consistent on triple-nested boxes, keep the conditional implication and record the shape-dependence obstruction.
If no common domain is supplied, do not convert the L4 interface into an operator or form theorem.
If a proposed use changes the established method or owner order, return to the continuity gate before proceeding.
